<style>
/* =========================================================================
   Personal Fitness Trainer — styles for the Elementor template
   Every rule is scoped to the .pft-* classes set on the template's
   containers/widgets, so it does not affect the rest of the site.
   This file is embedded in the template (first "HTML" widget). You can
   also paste it in Appearance > Customize > Additional CSS instead.
   ========================================================================= */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

.pft-section {
  --pft-orange: #f9652f;
  --pft-black: #121212;
  --pft-card-dark: #1c1c1c;
  --pft-light: #f8f8f8;
  --pft-text: #121212;
  --pft-muted: #6f6f6f;
  --pft-font: 'Instrument Sans', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-family: var(--pft-font);
  color: var(--pft-text);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
body .pft-section .elementor-heading-title,
body .pft-section .elementor-widget-text-editor,
body .pft-section .elementor-button,
body .pft-section .elementor-icon-list-text,
body .pft-section .elementor-toggle-title,
body .pft-section .elementor-tab-content,
body .pft-section input,
body .pft-section textarea,
body .pft-section button {
  font-family: var(--pft-font);
}
body .pft-section .elementor-heading-title { color: inherit; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
body .pft-section .elementor-widget-text-editor { color: inherit; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; }
body .pft-section .elementor-widget-text-editor p { margin: 0 0 14px; }
body .pft-section .elementor-widget-text-editor p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
body .pft-section .elementor-widget-image img { vertical-align: middle; }

/* Style holder (first container): invisible on the live page */
.pft-styles { padding: 0 !important; min-height: 0 !important; height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
body.elementor-editor-active .pft-styles { height: auto; min-height: 24px !important; }

/* ---------- Typography helpers ---------- */
body .pft-section .pft-label .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--pft-muted); }
body .pft-section .pft-h1 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 64px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.05em; color: #fff; }
body .pft-section .pft-h2 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; }
body .pft-section .pft-h3 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
body .pft-section .pft-muted { color: var(--pft-muted); font-size: 14px; }
body .pft-section .pft-stars .elementor-heading-title { color: #f5b301; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 2px; line-height: 1; }

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
body .pft-section .pft-btn .elementor-button {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
  background: var(--pft-orange); color: var(--pft-black);
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0;
  padding: 4px 4px 4px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--pft-orange);
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
body .pft-section .pft-btn .elementor-button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(249,101,47,.35); }
body .pft-section .pft-btn .elementor-button-content-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; flex-direction: row; }
body .pft-section .pft-btn .elementor-button-text { order: 1; }
body .pft-section .pft-btn .elementor-button-icon,
body .pft-section .pft-arrow .elementor-button-icon {
  order: 2; margin: 0 !important;
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--pft-black); color: #fff; fill: #fff;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 15px;
}
body .pft-section .pft-btn .elementor-button-icon svg,
body .pft-section .pft-arrow .elementor-button-icon svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: #fff; }
body .pft-section .pft-btn--outline .elementor-button { background: #fff; border-color: var(--pft-black); }
body .pft-section .pft-btn--outline .elementor-button:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
body .pft-section .pft-btn--block,
body .pft-section .pft-btn--block .elementor-button { width: 100%; }
body .pft-section .pft-btn--block .elementor-button-content-wrapper { width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; }
/* Icon-only square arrow button */
body .pft-section .pft-arrow .elementor-button { background: transparent; padding: 0; border: 0; line-height: 0; }
body .pft-section .pft-arrow .elementor-button-text { display: none; }

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
body .pft-hero { color: #fff; }
body .pft-hero .pft-badge .elementor-icon-list-items { display: inline-flex; }
body .pft-hero .pft-badge .elementor-icon-list-item {
  background: rgba(18,18,18,.85); border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 16px; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; gap: 8px;
}
body .pft-hero .pft-badge .elementor-icon-list-icon i { color: #fff; font-size: 18px; }
body .pft-hero .pft-badge .elementor-icon-list-icon svg { fill: #fff; width: 18px; height: 18px; }
body .pft-hero .pft-badge .elementor-icon-list-text { color: #fff; padding: 0; }
body .pft-hero .pft-trust-avatars img { width: 88px; height: 44px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 22px; }
body .pft-hero .pft-trust-text { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #fff; }
body .pft-hero .pft-trust-text p { margin: 0 !important; }
body .pft-hero .pft-trust-text .pft-star { color: #f5b301; }
body .pft-hero-card { background: var(--pft-orange); border-radius: 16px; color: var(--pft-black); transition: transform .2s ease; }
body .pft-hero-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
body .pft-hero-card .elementor-icon { color: var(--pft-black); font-size: 22px; }
body .pft-hero-card .elementor-icon svg { fill: var(--pft-black); width: 22px; height: 22px; }
body .pft-hero-card .elementor-widget-text-editor { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--pft-black); }
body .pft-hero .pft-hero-note { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); }

/* ---------- Stats ---------- */
body .pft-stats .pft-stat-number .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 60px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
body .pft-stats .pft-stat-title .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
body .pft-stats .pft-muted { line-height: 1.5; }

/* ---------- Testimonial ---------- */
body .pft-testimonial .pft-quote .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.045em; }
body .pft-section .pft-avatar img { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; }
body .pft-section .pft-avatar--lg img { width: 72px; height: 72px; }
body .pft-section .pft-author-name .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

/* ---------- About ---------- */
body .pft-about .pft-about-media { border-radius: 32px; overflow: hidden; }
body .pft-about .pft-signature img { width: 150px; }
body .pft-about .pft-value {
  background: var(--pft-light); border-radius: 24px;
}
body .pft-about .pft-value .elementor-icon { color: var(--pft-black); font-size: 24px; }
body .pft-about .pft-value .elementor-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
body .pft-about .pft-value .elementor-widget-text-editor { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
body .pft-logos .elementor-widget-image img { height: 42px; width: auto; opacity: .75; filter: grayscale(1); }

/* ---------- Services (dark) ---------- */
body .pft-services { color: #fff; }
body .pft-services .pft-label .elementor-heading-title { color: #fff; }
body .pft-services .pft-card {
  background: var(--pft-card-dark); border-radius: 24px; transition: background .2s ease;
}
body .pft-services .pft-card:hover { background: #232323; }
body .pft-services .pft-card .elementor-icon { color: #fff; font-size: 22px; }
body .pft-services .pft-card .elementor-icon svg { fill: #fff; width: 22px; height: 22px; }
body .pft-services .pft-card .pft-card-text { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
body .pft-services .pft-city .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 60px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.05em; }
body .pft-services .pft-card-img img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 16px; }
body .pft-services .pft-card-img,
body .pft-services .pft-card-img > .elementor-widget-container { height: 100%; }
body .pft-services .pft-intro { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 400px; }

/* ---------- Process ---------- */
body .pft-process .pft-img img { width: 100%; border-radius: 24px; aspect-ratio: 540 / 412; object-fit: cover; }
body .pft-process .pft-step-num .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--pft-muted); letter-spacing: 0; }
body .pft-process .pft-step-title .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }

/* ---------- Programs / pricing ---------- */
body .pft-programs .pft-h2 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 56px; }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-card { background: var(--pft-light); border-radius: 32px; position: relative; transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-card--featured { background: var(--pft-orange); }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-icon .elementor-icon {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--pft-black);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 17px;
}
body .pft-programs .pft-price-icon .elementor-icon svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-card--featured .pft-price-icon .elementor-icon { background: var(--pft-black); color: #fff; }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-card--featured .pft-price-icon .elementor-icon svg { fill: #fff; }
body .pft-programs .pft-popular { position: absolute !important; top: 20px; right: 20px; width: auto !important; }
body .pft-programs .pft-popular .elementor-heading-title {
  background: var(--pft-black); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0;
  padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 6px; line-height: 1;
}
body .pft-programs .pft-price .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 40px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
body .pft-programs .pft-price .elementor-heading-title span { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-desc { min-height: 44px; }
body .pft-programs .pft-price-card > .elementor-widget-button { margin-top: auto; }
body .pft-programs .pft-included .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: #4a4a4a; }
body .pft-programs .pft-checks .elementor-icon-list-item { padding: 6px 0 !important; font-size: 14px; }
body .pft-programs .pft-checks .elementor-icon-list-text { color: #2b2b2b; padding-left: 12px !important; }
body .pft-programs .pft-checks .elementor-icon-list-icon i { color: var(--pft-black); font-size: 13px; }
body .pft-programs .pft-checks .elementor-icon-list-icon svg { fill: var(--pft-black); width: 13px; }

/* ---------- Results ---------- */
body .pft-results .pft-img img { width: 100%; border-radius: 24px; }

/* ---------- FAQ (Toggle widget) ---------- */
body .pft-faq .elementor-toggle .elementor-tab-title {
  border: 0; padding: 26px 24px 26px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--pft-text);
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
}
body .pft-faq .elementor-toggle .elementor-toggle-title { color: var(--pft-text); }
body .pft-faq .elementor-toggle .elementor-toggle-icon { color: var(--pft-text); }
body .pft-faq .elementor-toggle .elementor-toggle-icon svg { fill: var(--pft-text); }
body .pft-faq .elementor-toggle .elementor-tab-content { border: 0; padding: 0 0 26px; color: var(--pft-muted); font-size: 15px; }

/* ---------- Contact ---------- */
body .pft-contact .pft-contact-card { background: var(--pft-light); border-radius: 24px; transition: background .2s ease; }
body .pft-contact .pft-contact-card:hover { background: #f1f1f1; }
body .pft-contact .pft-contact-card .elementor-icon { color: var(--pft-black); font-size: 24px; }
body .pft-contact .pft-contact-card .elementor-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
body .pft-contact .pft-contact-card .pft-h3 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; }
body .pft-contact .pft-form-title .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 500; }
.pft-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
.pft-form label { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #121212; }
.pft-form input, .pft-form textarea {
  width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px;
  background: transparent; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: #121212; outline: none;
  transition: background .2s ease;
}
.pft-form input:focus, .pft-form textarea:focus { background: #f8f8f8; }
.pft-form textarea { min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 0; }
.pft-form ::placeholder { color: #8a8a8a; }
.pft-form button {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%;
  background: #f9652f; color: #121212; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 24px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 4px;
}
.pft-form button span.pft-form-arrow {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 6px; background: #121212; color: #fff;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
/* Same look for Contact Form 7 / WPForms if you replace the HTML form with a shortcode */
.pft-form-wrap .wpcf7 input:not([type=submit]), .pft-form-wrap .wpcf7 textarea,
.pft-form-wrap .wpforms-form input, .pft-form-wrap .wpforms-form textarea {
  width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 14px 16px;
}
.pft-form-wrap .wpcf7 input[type=submit], .pft-form-wrap .wpforms-form button[type=submit] {
  width: 100%; background: #f9652f; color: #121212; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 24px; font-weight: 500;
}

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  body .pft-section .pft-h1 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 52px; }
  body .pft-section .pft-h2 .elementor-heading-title,
  body .pft-programs .pft-h2 .elementor-heading-title,
  body .pft-testimonial .pft-quote .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 40px; }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  body .pft-section .pft-h1 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 40px; }
  body .pft-section .pft-h2 .elementor-heading-title,
  body .pft-programs .pft-h2 .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 34px; }
  body .pft-testimonial .pft-quote .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 28px; }
  body .pft-stats .pft-stat-number .elementor-heading-title,
  body .pft-services .pft-city .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 44px; }
  body .pft-process .pft-step-title .elementor-heading-title { font-size: 26px; }
  body .pft-logos .elementor-widget-image img { height: 30px; }
  body .pft-section .pft-h1 br { display: none; }
  body .pft-services .pft-card-img img { max-height: 360px; }
  body .pft-contact .pft-contact-card { min-height: 180px !important; }
}

</style>

settings.title: “After two kids, I never thought I’d feel this strong again. Rachel Stone helped me rebuild my body and confidence.”

settings.editor: Postnatal Reboot - November 2025

For years, I thought strength meant doing more — training harder, eating cleaner, sleeping less. I pushed through exhaustion, believing discipline would bring freedom. It didn’t.

When burnout finally forced me to slow down, I started listening. I studied how movement, hormones, rest, and mindset work together — and rebuilt my strength through awareness, not pressure.

Now I help women do the same: feel capable and confident again without sacrificing themselves to get there. My approach blends science and empathy — habit-based, psychology-first, and built for lasting balance

If you’re new here or wondering what to expect, these answers will guide you through how coaching works, what’s included, and how we tailor every plan to your needs.

tabs.tab_title: What should I expect during my first session?
tabs.tab_content: We start with a relaxed conversation about your goals, history and schedule, followed by a short movement assessment. You leave with clear first steps — no pressure, no judgement.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need a gym membership?
tabs.tab_content: No. Programs can be built for a gym, a home setup with minimal equipment, or a mix of both.

tabs.tab_title: How often should I train each week?
tabs.tab_content: Most clients train 3–4 times per week. Your plan is adapted to your energy, recovery and lifestyle.
Yes. Every package includes nutrition guidance, from simple fundamentals to fully personalised plans.

tabs.tab_title: Can I cancel or pause my plan anytime?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, you can pause or cancel at any time. Life happens — your plan should flex with it.

tabs.tab_title: How long will it take to see results?
tabs.tab_content: Most clients feel more energy within 2–3 weeks and see visible changes within 6–8 weeks of consistent training.
